placement: Flag value injected as AccessLogValve pattern via HTTP parameter data binding (class.[module.]classLoader.resources.context.parent.pipeline.first.pattern). The valve writes a text file containing the flag into the webapp's served directory.
detection: GET /<marker>.txt returns the flag token in the response body
notes: The flag is NOT pre-planted in the container. It is written by the exploit itself (AccessLogValve reconfiguration). This is a state-write canary: presence of the flag text in the served marker file proves the data binding traversed the classLoader property path successfully.
